82d6665b24df78b6bafb05531e67f4b1f887eb01
Record P4 qualification result: whole-core route is prefill-only

The owner directed a P4 qualification of the p40-whole-core-v10 dev route
before deciding on promotion. Unlocking the O1 lock (40001->40016, O1->O16)
across the 9 pinning constants/ledgers let the engine create and the server
become healthy, but the real P40000/O16 run failed at the first decode step
(operation=full_gqa dependency_error=5 cuda_error=1 layer=3): the whole-core
layer-major views never populate the key_cache/value_cache views the decode
full_gqa kernel reads. The route is prefill-only by design; the 89.7s number
is pure prefill and the single O1 token comes from the prefill tail. It cannot
serve a multi-token completion, so it cannot be promoted as a production
route; the split-P route (219.8s, O16-capable) remains the only route meeting
the full prefill+decode contract. The O16 unlock was reverted; the only
retained change is a server diagnostic that prints the failure operation and
layer (previously only the always-empty context was shown).
history.3c76516:
3c765164791284dfc61c471d26bec48e381df723
Fix whole-core decode scratch sizing; qualify hybrid O16 prefill+decode

The first O16 attempt failed at the first decode full_gqa step with
cudaErrorInvalidValue. Root cause: the whole-core workspace plan sized the
legacy C512 fp32 scratch from prompt_token_count (40000 x 24 = 960,000) while
launch_gqa_attention_reference_cuda requires query_head_count x
sequence_length (24 x 40001 = 960,024). The production split-P plan sizes the
same scratch from the sequence capacity, which is why the shared decode kernel
works there. The decode path is fully shared: map_layer_major_candidate_views
handles the whole-core profile and the GDN decode steps before the first
full-attention layer succeed.

Synchronize the three mirrored sizing sites to the request sequence capacity
(prefill_workspace_plan.cpp planner + byte-exact ledger, request_state.cpp
cross-check mirror, reference_runner_layer_major_views.cpp
validate_legacy_regions) and unlock O16 on the dev route (40001 -> 40016,
max_output 1 -> 16, arena 8'640'542'976 -> 8'641'684'992). The real P40000/O16
API run now completes end-to-end: prefill 90.07 s, finish_reason length, 16
coherent tokens. Output diverges from the split-P baseline at tokens 4-6 (a
tie-prone paraphrase position, cf. P513) and converges afterwards, consistent
with the same accepted BF16 numerical class. Changes remain confined to the
default-off dev route; the production plan is unchanged. Remaining P4 gates:
full-state liveness oracle, stability envelope, four-layer production gate.
history.8fe4e67:
8fe4e676971813dbaeccd90be850a63e06c8abcd
Promote whole-core to the second qualified production deployment profile

Owner-promoted kP40WholeCoreV1 (q3x.sm87.production.p40.whole-core.v1),
selected with --production-profile p40-whole-core-v1, alongside the
unchanged Legacy-C512 production plan.

- CMake: Q3X_BUILD_P40_WHOLE_CORE_PRODUCTION_ROUTE (default OFF) reuses the
  nine-item whole-core inventory; production binary keeps the canonical
  qwen3x-eval-server name; new orin-p40-whole-core-prod preset; the
  PRODUCTION_ROUTE macro reaches both the gateway and server targets.
- Server: sealed kP40WholeCoreV1ProductionPlan with the captured sidecar
  inventory (fp8_output 64/2013265920, down_scale6 53/221429760, retained
  2234695680, supermatrix/gate_up/down_consumer 0) plus static_asserts;
  valid_options accepts exactly one of legacy/whole-core/dev; dedicated
  whole-core load-receipt branch (fail-closed, reused per request by
  runtime health); production_identity reports the active plan.
- Witness: whole_core_production_qualified flag keeps the v10 dev candidate
  plan ID but reports accuracy-qualified-production-deployment with
  numerical_contract.qualified=true.
- CLI: --production-profile p40-whole-core-v1 (atomic, mutually exclusive
  with --development-route).

Real-model verification (clean host, P40000/O16): 94.1 s wall, output
sha256 bitwise identical to the dev route, witness qualified=true,
identity exact; four negative tests rejected before model load.
ADR-0002 records the owner capacity tradeoff (fixed P40000/O16, arena
8641684992 vs 3070908416, O16 vs O4096).
